tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// na maḥgu ru gu h+ya kro ta ra dza maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ dkon mchog gsum dngos rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gtso/ /zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bdag /gsang chen bzang po'i 'phrin las bstan pa'i dpal/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos dbyings 'od gsal bde ldan zhing khams su/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i chos sku snang brnyan ni/ /dmar gsal mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar 'od dpag med/ /chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs/ /'og min bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /bde stong gnyis med khrag 'thung khro bo'i gar/ /yang gsang khros pa'i dpal chen dkyil 'khor pa/ /longs sku pad+ma dbang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /nub phyogs o rgyan rnga yab dpal ri'i rtser/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus rig 'dzin che/ /srin po'i kha gnon skye dgu yongs kyi gnyen/ /sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /nags rgyal lha chu mtshan ldan sgrub gnas su/ /pad+mas rjes bzung rab dga'i sa la gnas/ /gangs can khrod 'dir grub thob 'dar char zhes/ /yongs su grags pa de nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan bo ston mkhas pa'i chos grwa ru/ /thos bsam sgom pas rang rgyud legs sbyangs nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel/ /chos rgyal brtson 'grus rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang phyogs nyan po'i dben gnas dam pa ru/ /zab dang rgya chen gdams pa'i mdzod bzung nas/ /skal ldan gdul bya skyong ba'i mkhas grub che/ /nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /brag ri dpal gyi gtsug lag khang chen du/ /rig gnas rgya mtsho'i mthar son mkhas pa'i mchog /gcig tu sgrub pa lhur len grub pa'i dbang / /mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs/ /gtsang stod mus srad dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin/

/khyad par lam 'di'i rtsa lag chag ston rje/ /kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam par grol ba'i gnas kyi yang rtse ru/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i sras kyi thu bo pa/ /snyan brgyud bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dpal yon can/ /chos rje rin chen bkra shis la gsol ba 'debs/ /gar bzhugs chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /bde stong gnyis med ye shes rol pa las/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i rba rlabs stong g.yo ba/ /rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi sgo mang gtsug lag tu/ /zab don smra ba'i gtsug rgyan mchog gyur pa/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal/ /bla chen chos dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan sa skya grang chen bla brang du/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbang 'byor zhing / /gsung ngag bstan pa'i sgron me mus srad pa/ /byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /snye thang bde mchog dpal gyi yang dben du/ /gsang chen gdams pas skal ldan rjes su 'dzin/ /mthu stobs nus pas nag phyogs phye mar 'thag /mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pas byin rlabs nags yug dgon pa ru/ /kun bzang dgon pa'i gnas lugs mngon du gyur/ /drag sngags grub pa'i snyan grags phyogs kun khyab/ /'khrul zhig rat+na bha dra la gsol ba 'debs/ /mang mkhar chu lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong du/ /blo gsal bung ba 'du ba'i pad+mo'i tshal/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bcud phyung gdams pa'i gter/ /drin can tshar pa smyon pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /'od yug lding ma dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /tshar pa chos rje'i sras kyi thu bo pa/ /bka' gter bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rig sngags 'chang / /pha rgod mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la gsol 'debs/ /de ltar rgyal ba dgon pas brgyud pa dang / /gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i bla ma ste/ /dus gsum rig 'dzin bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/

/bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dam pas rjes bzung zhing / /yang gsang khros pa'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /khrag 'thung rgyal po myur du 'grub par shog /sgrub chen bka' brgyad snying po pad+ma'i dbang / /gsang las yang gsang khros pa nying khu'i brgyud/ /'phags yul grub dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po bai ro'i zhabs/ /gangs can grub mchog dpal ldan 'dar gyi char/ /thugs kyi nying khu zhal gyi gdams pa 'di/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin 'khrul med legs rtogs te/ /rtse gcig brtson pas nyams su len par shog /rnam dag brtson pas bdag brgyud legs smin cing / /rim gnyis zab mo'i rtogs pa ldan byas nas/ /gnas skabs las bzhi 'phrin las kun 'grub ste/ /kun bzang dgongs pa mngon du 'gyur bar shog /lte ba'i dbus nas mchog gi 'od dmar gyis/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /mun khung sgron me btegs pa ji bzhin du/ /gsal dwangs snang ba'i bskyed rim rtogs par shog /de ltar snang ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kun/ /legs par brtags tshe skye 'gag gnas gsum dang / /gdod nas bral ba'i sems nyid gdod ma'i rtsal/ /stong nyid rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtogs par shog /de nas chu zla bar snang 'ja' tshon ltar/ /rang bzhin brtags na bden par ma grub cing / /med cing snang ba mi 'gag gdod ma'i gshis/ /zung 'jug ngang nas sku gnyis mngon gyur shog /dregs pa'i rgyal po gying chen sde lnga dang / /gza' gdong drag po gnod sbyin lcam dral sogs/ /ji ltar bsgo ba'i bka' las mi 'da' bar/ /gsang chen bstan pa srung ba'i mthu ldan shog /mkha' la rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i char sprin 'thibs/ /bar na rnal 'byor gsang sngags 'brug stong sgrog /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char chen gyis/ /sgrub mchog phun tshogs 'bras bu 'grub par shog /ces yang gsang brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di/
